_comment: Mechanical contract between the PCB generator, the housing and the docs. Coordinates in mm, origin at the board centre, +X right, +Y up when looking at the LENS side (top) of the board.

lens_holder.part: Commonlands CLA021-LCP M12 board-mount lens holder (LCP, 20 mm hole spacing, 2 screws)
lens_holder.ear_note: ear_span_* is an ASSUMED envelope for the two screw ears (holes at x=+-10, 1.5 mm of material beyond each hole); Commonlands publishes only the 17 x 17 mm footprint and the 20 mm hole spacing. Check against the CLA021 STP.
lens_holder.screw_part: Commonlands CLA904-SCR, Phillips M1.6 x 5 thread-forming (head diameter and height not published by Commonlands)
lens_holder.lens_part: Commonlands CIL023-F2.2-M12B650 (EFL 2.2 mm, f/2.2, 650 nm IR-cut, -5 % TV distortion, 7.2 mm image circle)
lens_holder.lens_height_note: Lens top = holder 7.4 + 14.6 = 22.0 mm above the PCB top. This is a design ALLOWANCE: the CIL023 mechanical drawing (STP) and back focal length are not published on the product page, so the stack keeps 2 mm more than the old 20.0 mm assumption. Replace with the measured value once the STP is read.
lens_holder.hfov_note: rectilinear 2*atan(1.92/2.2) on the 3.84 mm OV9281 width. Real HFOV with the lens distortion is larger (about 84 to 85 deg, model estimate); calibrate k1..k3 on the camera.

status_leds_note: Status LEDs sit on the flat part of the front-cover roof (more than 18.5 mm from the lens axis; inside that radius the roof is a 45 deg cone), above the USB-C receptacle, so the 2.0 mm light-pipe bores are perpendicular to the roof.
keepout_note: FPGA (17x17 BGA, bottom, centre (0,-8)), RP2350, flash, regulators and passives are on the bottom side. Only the sensor, lens holder, two status LEDs and the USB-C shield tabs are on the top side.
